### Which file should I download?

- **Windows** (normal install): `ManageFreak-Setup-1.1.1.exe`
- **Windows** (nothing to install): `ManageFreak-1.1.1-portable.exe`
- **macOS Apple Silicon** (M1/M2/M3/M4): `ManageFreak-1.1.1-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS Intel**: `ManageFreak-1.1.1.dmg`
- **Linux**: `ManageFreak-1.1.1.AppImage`, or `managefreak_1.1.1_amd64.deb` for Debian/Ubuntu

If you already have 1.1.0 installed, you do not need any of these: the app updates itself
from its menu (top-left). The other files (`*.blockmap`, `latest*.yml`, macOS `.zip`) are
support files for the automatic updater.

---

### ⚠️ If you are on 1.0.3 or earlier
This is the first version line with the built-in updater, so **1.0.3 cannot update itself**:
download and install once by hand. From 1.1.0 onwards the installed Windows build updates
itself from the app menu.

---

### New in 1.1.1

- **Interface zoom**, for 13-14 inch laptops and high Windows scaling: controls in the
  app-name menu (top-left) or `Ctrl +`, `Ctrl -`, `Ctrl 0` and `Ctrl + mouse wheel`.
  From 70% to 150% in 10% steps, remembered between runs; on small screens the app now
  starts at 85% instead of 100%.

### Added in 1.1.0

- **Batch volume edit**: set the Volume (from **−12 to +12 dB**, as shown on the
  MicroFreak) of all selected presets at once, on the device or in the PC library.
- **In-app updates** (installed Windows build only): current version, changelog of the
  latest release and one-click update from the app-name menu.
- Samples now accept **any** `.wav` (auto-converted to mono PCM16, resampled to 32 kHz
  with an anti-aliasing filter, max 24 s).
- Full device backup and restore: one file with all 512 presets, wavetables, samples and
  device settings; choose what to restore, and samples that are already identical are
  skipped.

### Fixed in 1.1.x

- **MIDI reliability**: ManageFreak now picks the correct ports by itself and connects to
  your MicroFreak automatically. This also fixes an intermittent bug where the app could
  stop seeing the MIDI ports (it was connecting to a generic Windows MIDI port and
  crashing), which forced restarts. MIDI is now handled natively (WinMM on Windows,
  CoreMIDI on macOS, ALSA on Linux) instead of relying on the browser layer.
- Clearer and more consistent interface (drag & drop indicator, light theme, dialogs).
- Various fixes for boring stuff.

---

### Notes

- ManageFreak is **unofficial** and not affiliated with Arturia.
- **Windows**: the installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn you:
  *More info → Run anyway*.
- **macOS**: the app is not signed or notarized; the README explains how to open it anyway.
- Found a problem? Please report it on GitHub or in the Reddit thread.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/GiovanniBitbyBit/managefreak/compare/v1.0.3...v1.1.1
